top10_lows.title: Horrible unethical business practice.
top10_lows.text:
I’ve been a paying subscriber of this app for quite some time and was initially very happy with how easy it made creating and sending invoices. However, I’m extremely disappointed with the recent change that limits users to only 10 invoices even with a paid subscription.

I pay $150 per year, which is not a small amount, and this new restriction makes the app practically unusable for anyone who invoices regularly. There was no clear notice or justification for such a drastic downgrade in service.

I strongly urge the developers to reconsider this decision or at least grandfather existing paying customers under the old plan. Until then, I can’t recommend this app to other professionals. It feels unfair to pay a premium price for a service that now delivers a fraction of its original value.

top10_lows.title: Very dodgy business and terrible value for money
top10_lows.text:

I invoice by the quarter and don’t exceed the limit they created. They have support agents (once you ask for a human - the default is an AI bot which is absolutely useless) who give completely opposite advice and will override the system one month but tell you it’s impossible to the next month. Highly highly dodgy and on top of that, not even a particularly good app! 

When you try and have an issue resolved they palm you off to Apple. 

Honestly do not waste your money or your time on this app!

⚠️ Warning to others: 
Suddenly limited to 10 invoices only
top10_lows.text:
⚠️ Warning to others: After 4+ years as a loyal customer — during which they already increased prices several times — they have now suddenly cut my plan to only 10 invoices unless I pay $300/year (was $150). This was never part of the agreement when I renewed my plan. This is an unfair price hike and a clear change to the core terms. top10_lows.title: Price goes up, quality stays the same.
top10_lows.text:
I’ve been using invoice simple for 9 years with yearly price increases for about 4 years in a row. Has there been a significant shift in the product? No, it’s been pretty much the same basic invoicing app. Are they hiring a heap more staff because they are working on the app improving customer experience? I highly doubt it, given the product has barely changed. Happy to be proven wrong if a dev wants to respond to this review. 

I’m actively looking for alternatives because it’s finally hit the point where I can no longer justify the price when there are free alternatives out there that do exactly the same thing. The paid alternatives within the same price are way more advanced. I encourage everyone to do the same, this company is super greedy. The end goal seems to be to milk customers as much as possible before everyone leaves and it goes bust. The essential and plus plans are unusable for most small businesses as they only allow you to send up to 3 and 10 invoices respectively. I mean.. at less than 120 invoices a year you may as well do it manually. Devs, as providers to mostly small business, who are now no different price wise from premium providers, what are you actually offering?
